title: XZ Utils Backdoor (CVE-2024-3094) — Supply chain compromise
root_cause: Malicious maintainer inserted obfuscated backdoor into build system over 2+ years of social engineering. No reproducible build verification. No multi-party review requirement for release artifacts.
resolution_type: Invariant: release_artifact_hash == reproducible_build_hash. Multi-signature requirement for releases. Build provenance attestation (SLSA Level 3+).
